messages:
maria: FYI I'm prepping payment-service for dedicated env. Quick q about secrets wiring before I push Terraform. Plan: move Vault path from `secret/redwood/payment` -> `secret/services/payment` and update ExternalSecrets mappings. Any gotchas?

derek: @maria sounds reasonable. Are you changing the Vault backend or just reorganizing paths? If backend changes we'll need the k8s SA policy update and possibly a new mount.

maria: just a path reorg within the same kv-v2 backend. Terraform will create the new kv secret and I'll add a rotation policy. Leaving old path read-only for a short window.

alex: small ping — ExternalSecrets needs the remote property name to match the key in Vault. If you rename keys, update `property` in the ExternalSecret spec.

maria: good call. here's the Terraform snippet I plan to apply: ```hcl
resource "vault_kv_secret_v2" "payment" {
  path = "secret/services/payment"
  data_json = jsonencode({
    DB_PASSWORD = var.db_password
  })
}
# keep old path as tombstone for 24h then delete
```

liam: can you paste the ExternalSecret manifest too? want to sanity-check the k8s secret key names.

maria: sure: ```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payment-secrets
spec:
  refreshInterval: 5m
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault
    kind: SecretStore
  target:
    name: payment
  data:
    - secretKey: DB_PASSWORD
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/services/payment
        property: DB_PASSWORD
```

derek: ^ that looks right. ExternalSecrets with the Vault provider uses `key` + `property`. Also make sure the k8s SA bound in the SecretStore has `read` access to that path.

maria: adding Terraform IAM tweak to attach vault read policy to the k8s service account in namespace `payment`. Will include in the same PR.

ops-bot: infra-bot: terraform plan OK for branch feature/payment-secrets (PR 789) — no destructive changes detected.

alex: note on rotation — KV v2 has versioning, but ensure our cache invalidator runs after rotation. Otherwise pods might keep old prefix cache.

maria: I'll add a post-rotation hook: `curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/cache/clear?prefix=payment` so runtime clears any cached KV prefixes.

liam: one final ask — can we schedule the cutover during low traffic? Prefer 01:00 PST. I'll be oncall.

maria: scheduled cutover 2025-02-12 01:00 PST. Plan: switch terraform to write to new path, update ExternalSecret ref, wait 10m for read-only verification, then flip write traffic, monitor errors for 30m, then delete old path after 2h.

derek: LGTM. @maria please drop the PR diff here when ready and I'll review the k8s changes (esp. RBAC/clusterrolebinding).

maria: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/789 — terraform + ExternalSecret manifest + helm values in the branch.

alex: quick approve from me on the k8s manifest; will double-check if clusterrolebinding is needed for cross-namespace access.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
